verdict.rationale: ChatGPT Work is documented to carry a larger task through to a reviewable result, and Voice can start separate tasks for longer work and check on them. The docs also mention running projects in parallel, keeping long-running work moving, and delegating to subagents. However, explicit 'run in the background' language appears only for scheduled recurring automations; it is not stated for a one-off delegated task, so background autonomy for ad-hoc delegation is implied rather than documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation that one-off delegated tasks run autonomously in the background with a completion handoff or notification, independent or hands-on corroboration of delegated background task execution.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can delegate a multi-step task that the assistant works on autonomously in the background and returns for my review

citations.quote: Turn on Work in the switcher when you want ChatGPT to carry a larger task through to a reviewable result.
ChatGPT Voice can start separate tasks for longer work, check existing tasks, and send follow-up instructions.
Run projects in parallel, work with files, use your computer, and keep long-running work moving from one desktop workspace.
In ChatGPT Work, ask ChatGPT to delegate independent work to subagents.
In the ChatGPT desktop app, enter `/goal` to start Goal mode.
